final_text: The app shall enable the user to receive their personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.
The app shall erase the user's personal data on request where the data are no longer necessary for the purpose for which they were collected.
note: original candidate said 'immediately'; source gives no deadline

final_text: The app shall by default process only the personal data necessary for each specific purpose.
The app shall encrypt personal data at rest on the user's device.
note: original candidate bundled encryption at rest and in transit

final_text: The app shall permit passwords of at least 64 characters in length.
The app shall verify prospective passwords against a list of commonly used or compromised values.
The app shall not require periodic password rotation in the absence of evidence of compromise.
The app shall support resizing of text up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality.
The app shall render a visible focus indicator for any keyboard-operable user interface component.
The app shall provide a text alternative for each non-text content element.
The app shall allow a user to use all self-monitoring features without creating an account.
note: added by author from prior fieldwork

final_text: The app shall present a plain-language summary of what data leave the device, before first data transmission.
note: added by author from prior fieldwork
